correctness.rationale: The full degree<=2 polynomial band restricts uniquely to edge Walsh coefficients h_i+h_j, ell_i s+ell_j t, gamma_ij st, with dimension 2d+C(d,2). All-edge Walsh orthogonality and triangle equations prove injectivity. For support<=4, a nonzero linear odd component yields at least 2r(d-r)+C(r,2)>=6 supported values. The even part induces an edge set F of at most two nonzero pair sums. Deleting <=2 edges from K_d leaves connected nonbipartite graph for d>=5, and at d=4 only deletion of a perfect matching leaves a four-cycle. Thus h=0 normally, yielding C(d,2) complete coordinate squares, while d=4 yields 3*2*2=12 further matching antipodal-pair unions, exactly 18 supports. The supplied exact Bareiss checker of 12950 d=4 erasure patterns was inspected as code, and the proof is independent of finite tests.
